tables.title: Player Damage Formula
tables.note: Player Damage is equal to the base stage damage + the number of surviving units on the enemy's board. For example, if you lose a player combat on Stage 2 and the opponent has 3 surviving units, you will take 2 + 3 = 5 damage.

tables.title: Upgraded Loot Roll
tables.note: Secretly rolled once at the start of the game to determine how many stages have "Upgraded" loot. The stage loot tables below already factor these odds in.
